boundary: Synthetic write into a throwaway state root; it is not a human acceptance record, and DL-KB-16 still waits on a named real person for its human_review axis.
crashRecordedHonestly: Before this commit landed, one full geometry run died at w=1536 with an uncaught locator TimeoutError waiting for #as-list .as-plan-open -- the plan list had no row to open, and the gate crashed instead of saying so. The step now checks for the row and quotes what #as-list-meta actually says before continuing. Two full runs since were clean, so the cause is NOT established and this receipt does not claim it was fixed -- what changed is that a recurrence names itself instead of killing the run.
howItSettles: The gate picks the first outcome word the service served (never a word of its own), fills the two fields the form requires, and reads the recorder name as "审计脚手架（合成，不是真人签署）" -- a gate row must not be able to read like a human sign-off later. It then waits for #as-fb-history to hold a row and for #as-fb-status to stop saying 正在读回 and not be a failure, and derives the row's state from that same line rather than hard-coding it.
whatWasUnmeasured: The feedback panel is the loop's last leg -- "record external usage if you wish" -- and both rulers stopped at the plan detail with the form empty. The history row, its tally cells and the 相同/未说明 wording only exist after a write, so nothing had ever measured them.
